prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1158; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the rear-end collision described in the claim you have opened under the reference assigned to this matter. Please direct all further communication regarding this claim, including requests for statements, recorded interviews, medical authorizations, and settlement discussions, to this office and not to our client. If your insured or any representative contacts our client directly, please let us know promptly.

Our client sustained injuries in the collision and is currently receiving treatment. We ask that you provide a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in force on the date of loss, along with the bodily injury and property damage limits applicable to this claim, and confirm whether any excess or umbrella coverage may apply.

We also request that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, repair estimates and the vehicle itself where it remains available, dash camera footage, claim notes, adjuster communications, and any recorded statements. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of such material until this matter is resolved.
